BiblicalUsage: The name is Samlah, an Edomite. You find the name in 1 Chronicles 1:47, "…when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned…", and again in Genesis 36:36 and 1 Chronicles 1:48.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Samlah counts, because God wrote the name down and I believe he meant it. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
